senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (बजति)
To go.
r. 10th cl. (वाजयति)
1 To go.
2 To prepare, to make.
3 To prepare the way.
4 To trim or feather an arrow.

mn. (-जः-जं)
A wing.
m. (-जः)
1 The feather of an arrow.
2 Speed.
3 Sound.
4 A Muni.
n. (-जं)
1 Ghee or clarified butter.
2 Water.
3 A Mantra or prayer which concludes a sacrifice.
4 Rice offered at a Śrāddha or obsequial ceremony.
5 Rice in general.
5 The acidulous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment.
E.
वज to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-ज्रः-ज्रा-ज्रं)
1 Hard, impenetrable, adamantine.
2 Cross, forked.
mn. (-ज्रः-ज्रं)
1 A thunder-bolt in general, or the thunder-bolt of INDRA.
2 The diamond, (the gem being considered analogous^1 in hardness to the thunder-bolt, or in fact to be the same substance.)
3 A diagram, the figure of which is supposed to be that of the thunder-bolt.
4 A child or pupil.
5 Emblic myrobalan.
6 Sour gruel.
7 The blossom of the sesamum.
8 Harsh language.
m. (-ज्रः)
1 One of the astronomical Yogas.
2 Kuśa grass.
f. (-ज्रा-ज्री)
A species of Euphorbia.
f. (-ज्रा)
1 A plant: see गुडुची.
2 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
वज to go, रक् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-कं)
A sort of salt, an impure carbonate of soda.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-टः)
Hanumān, the monkey demigod.
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and कङ्कट armour.

m. (-कः)
Euphorbia.
E.
वज्र a thunder-bolt, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-ली)
One of the Bauddha saints.

n. (-रं)
An alkaline earth, an impure carbonate of soda.
E.
वज्र diamond, and क्षार alkali.

m. (जित्)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, and जित् who conquers; being invulnerable to repeated shocks of INDRA'S bolt.

f. (-ला)
A clap of thunder.
E.
वज्र the bolt, and ज्वाला flame.

m. (-कः)
A Jaina deified saint.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 The deity GAṆEŚA.
2 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
3 A vulture.
4 A gnat, a musquito.
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, and तुण्ड face or beak, as hard.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A hog.
2 A rat.
E.
वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and दन्त a tooth.

m. (-नः)
A rat.
E.
वज्र, and दशन a tooth: see the last.

m. (-द्रुः)
Euphorbia of various species.
E.
वज्र thunderbolt, (as hard,) and द्रु a tree; also वज्रद्रुम.

m. (-मः)
Euphorbia: see the last.

m. (-रः)
1 INDRA, as the JUPITER Tonans of the Hindus.
2 A Bauddha saint.
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, and धर who has or holds.

m. (-षः)
A clap of thunder.
E.
वज्र the bolt, and निर्घोष sound.

m. (-षः)
A clap of thunder.
E.
वज्र the bolt, and निष्पेष here meaning the sound produced by friction or concussion, from निर् forth, पिष to grind, aff. घञ्.

m. (-णिः)
INDRA.
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, and पाणि the hand: see वज्रधर.

m. (-तः)
A thunder-bolt, a stroke of lightning.
E.
वज्र, and पात fall.

n. (-ष्पं)
The blossom of the sesamum.
E.
वज्र a diamond, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-धः)
1 Death by lightning.
2 Cross multiplication.
E.
वज्र, and बय killing, or multiplying.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Hard, adamantine.
2 Hard-hearted.
E.
वज्र, and मयट् aff.

m. (-दः)
A hog.
E.
वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and रद a tooth.

f. (-ल्ली)
A species of sun-flower, (Heliotropium.)
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, and वल्ली a creeper.

f. (-ही)
A female personification of Māyā or unreality, amongst the Bauddhas.

f. (-ला)
A female deification peculiar to the Jainas, and one of their sixteen Vidyā-Devīs.
E.
वज्र a diamond^1, and शृङ्खला a chain.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A Jaina saint.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A snake.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.)
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and अङ्ग body or substance.

m. (-तः)
1 A thunder-bolt or stroke.
2 A sudden calamity.
E.
वज्र^1, and आघात blow.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-भः)
Precious Opal.
E.
वज्र the diamond, (in hardness perhaps,) आभ resembling.

m. (-सः)
Cross multiplication.
E.
वज्र, and अभ्यास practising.

m. (निः)
INDRA'S thunder-bolt.

m. (-ज्री)
1 INDRA.
2 A Jaina deified saint.
3 A buffalo.
E.
वज्र the thunder-bolt, and इनि aff.

mn. (-यः-यं)
A particular sacrifice.
E.
वाज the acetous fermentation of meal and water, and पेय to be drank, (by the gods.)

m. (-जी)
A particular sacrifice: see the last.
E.
वाज sour gruel, भुज to eat, aff. णिनि, and the radical vowel changed.

m. (-न्धः)
The name of a plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
वाजिन् a horse, and गन्ध smell; also वाजिगन्धक.

f. (-ता)
1 The condition of having wings.
2 The nature of a horse.
E.
वाजिन् a horse, &c., तल् aff.; also with त्व, वाजित्वं.

m. (-न्तः)
A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.)
E.
वाजि a horse, and दन्त a tooth, to which the flower is compared; also with कन् added, वाजिदन्तक.

m. (-जी)
1 A horse.
2 An arrow.
3 A bird.
4 A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.)
f. (-जिनी)
A mare.
E.
वाज speed or a feather, &c., and इनि poss. aff.

n. (-नं)
Curd of two milk whey, or the whey from which the curds have been separated.
E.
वज to prepare, aff. इनन्.

m. (-ष्ठः)
Globe amaranth.
E.
वाजि a horse, and पृष्ठ back.

f. (-मिः)
Place where horses are bred.
E.
वाजिन्, and भूमि place.

nf. (-लं-ला)
A stable.
E.
वाजि a horse, and शाला a hall.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Aphrodisiac.
E.
वाजिन् a horse, कर what makes, च्चि aff.

n. (-णं)
Stimulus or excitement of amorous desires by aphrodisiacs, &c.
E.
वाजि a horse, करण making, and च्चि augment.
